newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mostly steady.

text.p: Millfeed prices remained mostly steady on Tuesday as some dealers noted a pickup in activity.
"We had a little bit of business but bids are still slow and offers keep coming down," one Texas dealer said.
A Minnesota dealer noted a strong grain market and pointed to some frost damage to Minnesota corn. Millfeed supplies are very tight, he said.
In the Carolinas, rain is hampering fieldwork. Millfeed prices are firmer when corn is hard to get, a Carolinas dealer said.
But in St Louis, nearby supplies are ample. Mills are running during the weekends to fill demand for flour and feed, a broker said.
